replacements.reason: Make GALE01's intentional command-table adjacency explicit: indexes 49 through 53 at 0x803C07AC through 0x803C07BC are the first five entries of the immediately adjacent skip-handler table. Native section slicing cannot rely on that DOL linker layout.
Route normal fighter script opcodes through the explicit GALE01 adjacency mapping instead of reading beyond a host C array.

Recover the PowerPC big-endian halfword value from the command's two named bytes. A native little-endian u16 pointer cast reverses GFX 0x0407 into 0x0704 even though the immutable command bytes retain source order.

Both runtime-created footstep sound commands are consumed through the big-endian CmdUnion layout. Preserve byte copies of the first and last words, but encode the computed numeric operand through its typed field. A host u32 store reverses IDs such as 359 and skips the original pitch-randomization RNG draw, affecting later stage and fighter state.
